title: FDA Approves First Treatment for Rare Thymidine Kinase 2 Deficiency
summary: The FDA approved UCB’s KYGEVVI, the first treatment for thymidine kinase 2 deficiency (TK2d), an ultra-rare fatal mitochondrial disease, reducing death risk by 86% in patients with early symptom onset.The postFDA Approves First Treatment for Rare Thymidine Kinase 2 Deficiencyappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
